submitted.rationale: Of the three merit measurements, index 0 (Fe0.84Sb0.16) gave the highest EQE: 0.0178%. Index 4 (Fe0.76) gave 0.0032% and index 13 (near FeSbO4) gave 0.0015%. EQE falls steeply as Sb rises, which fits hematite-like Fe-rich material absorbing the 2.1 eV light. So the most Fe-rich composition is the best.

rejected.reason: measured 0.0015% EQE; this is the rutile FeSbO4 region, which performs poorly
not measured. The downward trend with Sb and the poor absorption of Sb-rich oxides at 2.1 eV make a high EQE there unlikely
